sections.description: Independent GRID-Arendal editorial plugin. Configure and update this product separately.
sections.changelog: Independent GRID Editorial Tools plugin: ACF groups/labels, optional content workspace and account icon, review/imports/notifications, protected files, maps and LMS adapters. Retains existing editorial settings and field/content keys. Safe staging beside combined 2.x; standalone operation without the widget; independent admin menu, assets, version and update feed.
